assertions.contract_summary: docs/CNAME exists on disk as a regular file.
assertions.rationale: docs/CNAME's existence is the load-bearing structural fact for GitHub Pages custom-domain routing; a short existence check is already the correct, minimal contract for this and needs no further extraction or conversion.

assertions.contract_summary: docs/CNAME's raw bytes equal exactly `monomidigest.com\n` (apex domain, single trailing newline, no BOM/extra whitespace).
assertions.rationale: The exact byte value, including the single trailing newline and the absence of any other character, is the actual GitHub Pages custom-domain configuration; this is an intentional exactness contract protecting production DNS routing, not an incidental verbatim lock on prose, so it must stay exact.

assertions.contract_summary: docs/CNAME does not contain the `http://` scheme.
assertions.rationale: GitHub Pages' CNAME file must hold a bare hostname; embedding a scheme is a known misconfiguration that silently breaks Pages' custom-domain matching, so this negative check guards that specific failure mode.

assertions.contract_summary: docs/CNAME does not contain the `https://` scheme.
assertions.rationale: Same failure mode as the `http://` check, covering the HTTPS-scheme variant of an accidentally-scheme-prefixed CNAME entry.

assertions.contract_summary: docs/CNAME does not contain a `/` path separator.
assertions.rationale: A path segment (not a bare hostname) in CNAME is rejected by GitHub Pages; this guards the bare-hostname requirement generally, independent of which scheme might have introduced the `/`.

assertions.contract_summary: docs/CNAME does not contain a `www.` subdomain prefix.
assertions.rationale: This repository's apex-domain decision (SD-011/SD-028) intentionally excludes the `www` subdomain from the CNAME file; this rejects an accidental switch to a `www.`-prefixed CNAME entry.

assertions.contract_summary: After removing the apex domain substring itself, no `www` remains anywhere in docs/CNAME.
assertions.rationale: Complements the `www.`-prefix check: this also rejects `www` appearing anywhere else in the file (e.g. a stray second line), closing a gap that a literal-prefix-only check would leave open.

assertions.contract_summary: docs/CNAME parses to exactly one line, `monomidigest.com`.
assertions.rationale: GitHub Pages ignores or breaks on multi-line CNAME files; this is the structural single-line contract for the file. The exact domain match here is confirmatory and complements, rather than replaces, the dedicated byte-exact contract in test_cname_content_is_exactly_the_apex_domain_with_trailing_newline.
